name: Google Calendar
description: Read-only Google Calendar agenda, week, and month views for e-ink displays.

settingsSchema.label: Calendar IDs
settingsSchema.description: Comma-separated calendar IDs. Use primary for your main calendar.

settingsSchema.label: Ignored phrases
settingsSchema.description: Comma-separated, case-insensitive partial matches against title and description.

settingsSchema.label: Time zone
settingsSchema.description: Optional IANA time zone such as Asia/Kolkata. Blank uses the calendar/API default.
